sources.ssWageBase: Social Security Administration 2026 wage base, $184,500 — corroborated by multiple secondary sources (ustax.tools, mjcpa.com), fetched 2026-09-25. Verify against ssa.gov's official 2026 fact sheet before production use.
sources.additionalMedicareThresholds: IRC Section 3101(b)(2) — statutory, NOT inflation-adjusted; unchanged since 2013 ($200k single/HOH, $250k MFJ, $125k MFS).
